title: BodyModel
description: Schema for a BodyModel compendium entry (Rpg/Compendium/BodyModel.cs). Describes the complete body of an entity: its stats, body part hierarchy, and entity-level features.

PartStatModifier.description: A stat modifier provided by a body part, scaled by the part's current health ratio.

stat.description: ID of the stat to modify.

atFull.description: Modifier value when the body part is at full health.

atZero.description: Modifier value when the body part is at 0 health. Defaults to 0 if omitted.

standaloneHPOnly.description: If true, this modifier only applies when the part uses its own standalone HP pool.

operation.description: How the modifier value is applied to the stat.

DamageModifier.description: A damage modifier applied to a specific damage type on a body part.

damageType.description: Name of the DamageType to modify.

BodyPartModel.description: A body part node in the body hierarchy.

name.description: Display name of the body part (e.g. 'Head', 'Left Arm').

group.description: Group category for this part (e.g. 'head', 'torso', 'arm'). Used for grouping in the UI and damage resolution.

maxHealth.description: Maximum health points of this body part.

area.description: Relative surface area used for hit-location probability. Higher area = more likely to be hit.

painMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to pain generated by injuries on this part. 1.0 = normal.

slots.description: Equipment slot identifiers available on this body part (e.g. 'hand', 'head').

providedStats.description: Stat modifiers provided to the entity owner, scaled by this part's health ratio.

damageModifiers.description: Damage type modifiers that apply when this part is hit.

skills.description: Skill compendium IDs granted to the entity while this part is present.

selfFeatures.description: Feature compendium IDs applied to the BodyPart entity itself.

features.description: Feature compendium IDs applied to the owning entity when this part is present.

stats.description: Base numeric stat values stored directly on this body part entity (keyed by stat ID).

metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON metadata for custom game logic or tooling. Not processed by the core engine.

children.description: Child body parts attached to this part (e.g. 'Hand' is a child of 'Arm').

StatDependency.description: Makes this stat's max or min depend on another stat's value.

value.description: Expression evaluated to resolve the max/min value from the dependency.

operation.description: How the dependency value is combined.

max.description: Maximum cap. If omitted, no upper cap is enforced (unless overCap is false).

min.description: Minimum cap. If omitted, no lower cap is enforced (unless underCap is false).

overCap.description: Whether the stat can exceed 'max'. Defaults to true (capped).

underCap.description: Whether the stat can go below 'min'. Defaults to true (capped).

aliases.description: Alternative IDs that can be used to reference this stat.

vital.description: If true, the entity dies (or similar) when this stat reaches its minimum.

regen.description: Amount regenerated (or drained if negative) per tick. Omit for no passive regen.

dependsOn.description: Makes this stat's effective max or min depend on other stats. Keys are stat IDs, values are NumberExprs.

groupEffectiveness.description: Per-body-part-group effectiveness multiplier for this stat (keyed by group name, value 0–1+).

name.description: Optional human-readable display name for the stat.

onChange.description: Effect evaluated whenever this stat's value changes.

BodyModel.description: Full body model for an entity.

name.description: Human-readable name of this body model (e.g. 'Human', 'Horse').

humanoid.description: Whether this body model is treated as humanoid (affects various gameplay systems).

features.description: Feature compendium IDs applied to the entity that owns this body.

stats.description: Entity-level stats keyed by stat ID.

root.description: The root body part (typically 'Torso' or 'Body'). All other parts are children of this.
